digest.component_or_area: DC rich text codec — wiki renderer module
propositions: Pandoc's jira reader misparses Markdown punctuation (arrows, ASCII tables, regex) causing character erosion across passes; a segmenting one-way renderer that converts only structurally-safe units and passes dangerous ones verbatim reaches ~68% body / ~78% char richness without corruption.

A pure `render_markdown_to_wiki` module must be delivered separately from the codec wiring to preserve codec law and avoid live cutover risk; `WikiTextCodec` remains fully identity in this story, with integration deferred to ticket 3388.

Code-aware arrow substitution must run on Markdown before pandoc to preserve code references (obj->method) while converting prose arrows (-> to →); the renderer must not rewrite any of 179 known code-arrow bodies in the fixture.
ASCII pipe-tables must be verbatim-wrapped in `{noformat}` blocks to prevent per-pass dash erosion; all 70 known erosion bodies in the fixture must remain stable across passes.

When pandoc is absent or errors, `render_markdown_to_wiki` must return input unchanged (identity passthrough) and log once to ensure echo safety; `pypandoc-binary` (bundled binary) is pinned to make the renderer self-contained.
All existing `WikiTextCodec` identity tests and codec-law tests must remain green unmodified; no observable DC behavior changes on merge of this story.
